title: Rahmah El Yunusiyyah
tagline: The girl from the mountains of Sumatra who opened a school for girls in 1923, never gave up, and was honoured by al-Azhar.
depictionNotes: Rahmah El Yunusiyyah (1900 to 1969) and the Minangkabau people of West Sumatra are drawn as themselves, every woman's hair covered, as in her own photographs. The facts come from published histories of her life (see the notes for parents). Pictures are AI-generated.
coverAlt: Rahmah welcomes girls arriving with their books at a mosque in the mountains of West Sumatra.
